Course Description
An introduction to the design and analysis of software systems.

Textbook
Any standard textbook on the subject.

Grading

A: 90% and above
B: 80% and above
C: 70% and above
D: 60% and above
F: Below 60%

40% for in-class written quizzes
10% homework assignments
10% for tearm project
20% for the midterm examination.
20% for the final examination.

You get participation points when you actively participate in the class by asking and answering questions.
